content: Internal Revenue Service Compliance Division, this is Officer Parker speaking. How may I assist you today?
Uh, yes, I received a message on my phone saying there's some issue with my taxes? I'm really worried, I don't want any trouble.
I understand your concern. Let me check our records. Could you confirm your full name and the phone number you received the message on? This will help me verify your IRS file.
Yes, my name is Sunil Mehra, and my number is 415-555-0121.

Thank you, Mr. Mehra. Please hold while I access your case... Alright, it seems there are discrepancies in your tax filings from 2021 and 2022. The system shows an unpaid balance and multiple compliance notifications have gone unanswered.
I thought I filed everything on time. What kind of balance? I never got anything in the mail.
According to the IRS database, you currently owe $6,840 in back taxes, penalties, and late fees. This issue is extremely serious, as we have already initiated pre-legal procedures on your account.
Pre-legal procedures? What does that mean? I can't have any issues, I'm on a work visa.

I'm sorry, but if this payment is not settled immediately, the IRS can freeze your bank accounts and begin asset seizure. It may also impact your immigration status, as unresolved tax debts are reported to Homeland Security.
Oh no, please, I can't lose my visa. I didn't know about any of this. What can I do to fix it?

If you act now, we can pause enforcement and resolve this without further escalation. However, you must not hang up or speak to anyone else about this call until we finish the process, or your case will be automatically referred for prosecution.
I understand. I won't say anything to anyone. Please, tell me what needs to be done.
First, I need to confirm how much you can pay toward your IRS balance today. Do you have access to your online banking or any payment methods right now?
I have some savings, but not the full amount. Maybe around three thousand dollars.

That's a good start. For immediate compliance and to avoid further penalties or possible arrest, you must make a partial payment now. The most secure methods are wire transfer, cryptocurrency, or prepaid gift cards, as standard bank payment lines are under audit.
Wait, gift cards? The IRS accepts those?

Due to updated federal protocols for flagged accounts, we're temporarily processing through secure prepaid methods. Please do not question the process, any delay or outside inquiry can trigger additional penalties.
Okay, okay, I don't want any more trouble. Where do I get these cards?

You can purchase Target or Apple gift cards at most major retailers. Buy them in increments of $500 or $1,000, up to your available funds. Remain on the line with me while you do this, do not speak to anyone at the store about your situation.
Alright, I can go to the Walgreens down the street. Should I get six cards of $500 each?
That would be perfect. As soon as you purchase them, scratch off the protective strip on the back and read each code to me so I can apply the payment directly to your file.
Okay, I'm going right now. Please stay on the line.
I will remain here with you. Remember, if anyone asks why you're buying gift cards, say they're for personal use. Discussing this case outside of this call can activate immediate enforcement.
Understood. I'm almost there. Should I call you back if we get disconnected?

If the call drops for any reason, call this direct IRS compliance number immediately. Failure to complete payment today will result in a warrant, and law enforcement may come to your address. Are you prepared to proceed?
Yes, I'm ready. Please, I just want to fix this and keep my job.
